prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["How to Interact with Your Desktop Companion", "Right-click your pet anytime to access quick settings, talk to it, or hide it to your system tray.", "Got It", "Right-click = Settings & Commands | Drag = Move around desktop"]
1: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe Across Devices", "Signing in ensures your adoption progress and pet memory are saved securely to your cloud account.", "Cloud Save Protected"]
2: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion World", "Choose how your companion lives on your desktop—active buddy or calm background helper.", "Select your vibe"]
3: []
4: ["Your desktop pet is rendering in the background. You can minimize this window anytime."]
5: ["Crafting Your Custom Companion..."]
6: ["Upload Clear Front-Facing Photos for Best Pet Model", "Use well-lit photos with clear backgrounds so our generator creates an accurate 3D avatar of your pet.", "Avoid dark lighting or obscured faces for optimal results."]
7: ["Includes Starter Toy & Desk Mini-Game"]
8: ["Building 3D Mesh & Idle Animations..."]
9: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Click launch to summon your companion directly onto your desktop workspace.", "Spawn Pet on Desktop"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or bundled items
